pick.name: OpenRouter Rankings
pick.what: Real usage share by model/app, open vs closed share, top models by task spend, cost per coding-agent session, plus the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
pick.why: Shows what developers actually pay for and how much an agent session costs, which is what a founder picking models for products needs

alts.name: Arena (ex-LMArena)
alts.what: Human-preference leaderboards: text, vision, WebDev, search, agent (with cost/task), image, video
alts.why: Best for 'which model do people prefer' and WebDev/agent comparisons; rebranded to Arena Jan 2026

alts.name: Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub
alts.what: 412 models x 95 benchmarks, Epoch Capabilities Index, CSV download (CC BY 4.0)
alts.why: Best for rigorous capability trends and raw data

candidates.name: OpenRouter Rankings
candidates.verdict: PICK: usage + cost + AA index in one page

candidates.name: Artificial Analysis
candidates.verdict: Strong price/speed/quality comparisons; not opened during research (TLS error), so not verified

decision: Check OpenRouter Rankings and Arena during the weekly radar; go to Epoch when you need hard numbers for a model decision. Never pick a production model from one leaderboard: run your own promptfoo evals.
details: LMArena rebranded 'Arena' (arena.ai) on 2026-01-28 per Wikipedia; lmarena.ai redirects.

verify.note: LMArena renamed 'Arena' on 2026-01-28 (Wikipedia, citing Arena blog 'LMArena is now Arena').
